lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as organized vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters. In the mid-flank, columns contain 4-5 prominent nodes, transitioning to a higher density of smaller clusters in the anterior region proximal to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are perceptible, aligning with the spot columns to create a grid-like structural arrangement across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper and middle thirds of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs across its visible dorsal surface.
